summary: GRANÅSVEIEN 3 AS (org. no. 988 270 695) is a private limited company (AS) based in Trondheim, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-06-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 24 660 and net income was -NOK 301 625. CEO: Terje Steen; board chair: Terje Steen.
